WITH principal AS ( SELECT mm.smaller_amount as Mini, mml.code as A, it.dian_code as B, rp.vat as C, rp.lastname1 as D, rp.lastname2 as E, rp.name1 as F, rp.name2 as G, rp.name as H, rc.medios_code as I, ( CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'J' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN SUM(aml.debit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'J' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN SUM(aml.credit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'J' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN SUM(aml.credit-aml.debit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'J' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN SUM(aml.tax_base_amount) END ) as J, ( CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'K' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN SUM(aml.debit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'K' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN SUM(aml.credit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'K' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN SUM(aml.credit-aml.debit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'K' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN SUM(aml.tax_base_amount) END ) as K FROM mag_media mm INNER JOIN mag_media_lines mml ON mml.magnetic_id = mm.id INNER JOIN mag_media_lines_concepts mmlc ON mmlc.line_id = mml.id INNER JOIN ( select aammlcr.account_account_id as account_id, aammlcr.mag_media_lines_concepts_id as concept_id from account_account_mag_media_lines_concepts_rel aammlcr union all select aaat.account_account_id as account_id, mmlcaat.concept_ids as concept_id from mag_media_lines_concepts_account_account_tag mmlcaat inner join account_account_tag aat on aat.id = mmlcaat.tag_ids inner join account_account_account_tag aaat on aaat.account_account_tag_id = aat.id ) as aa on aa.concept_id = mmlc.id INNER JOIN account_move_line aml ON aml.account_id = aa.account_id LEFT JOIN res_partner rp ON rp.id = aml.partner_id LEFT JOIN l10n_latam_identification_type it ON it.id = rp.l10n_latam_identification_type_id LEFT JOIN res_country rc ON rc.id = rp.country_id WHERE mm.id = {id} AND aml.date BETWEEN '{date_from}' AND '{date_to}' AND aml.parent_state = 'posted' AND aml.company_id = {company_id} GROUP BY mml.code, it.dian_code, rp.vat, rp.name1, rp.name2, rp.lastname1, rp.lastname2, rp.name, rc.medios_code, mmlc.sequence, mmlc.type, mm.smaller_amount ) SELECT A as "Concepto", B as "Tipo documento", C as "Número de identificación de informado", D as "Primer apellido del informado", E as "Segundo apellido del informado", F as "Primer nombre del informado", G as "Segundo nombre del informado", H as "Nombre informado", I as "Código país", SUM(J) as "Ingresos brutos recibidos", SUM(K) as "Devoluciones, rebajas y descuentos" FROM ( SELECT A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, SUM(J) AS J, SUM(K) AS K FROM principal GROUP BY A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, Mini HAVING SUM(J) >= Mini::float
UNION
SELECT A, '43' as B, '222222222' as C, '7' as D, '' as E, '' as F, '' as G, 'CUANTIAS MENORES' as H, NULL as I, SUM(J) as J, SUM(K) as K FROM ( SELECT Mini, A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, SUM(J) AS J, SUM(K) AS K FROM principal GROUP BY A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, Mini HAVING SUM(J) < Mini::float ) AS cm GROUP BY A, Mini ) AS datos GROUP BY A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I ORDER BY C
